shortDescription: Manage C(schematics_actions) for Schematics Service API.

options.name: action_id
options.description: Action Id.  Use GET /actions API to look up the Action Ids in your IBM Cloud account.

options.name: bastion
options.description: Describes a bastion resource.

options.name: bastion_connection_type
options.description:
Type of connection to be used when connecting to bastion host.
If the C(inventoryI(connection)type=winrm), then C(bastionI(connection)type) is not supported.

options.name: bastion_credential
options.description: User editable credential variable data and system generated reference to the value.

options.name: command_parameter
options.description: Schematics job command parameter (playbook-name).

options.name: credentials
options.description: credentials of the Action.

options.name: description
options.description: Action description.

options.name: force
options.description: Equivalent to -force options in the command line.

options.name: inputs
options.description: Input variables for the Action.

options.name: inventory
options.description: Target inventory record ID, used by the action or ansible playbook.

options.name: inventory_connection_type
options.description:
Type of connection to be used when connecting to remote host.
B(Note) Currently, WinRM supports only Windows system with the public IPs and do not support Bastion host.

options.name: location
options.description:
List of locations supported by IBM Cloud Schematics service.
While creating your workspace or action, choose the right region, since it cannot be changed.
Note, this does not limit the location of the IBM Cloud resources, provisioned using Schematics.

options.name: name
options.description:
The unique name of your action.
The name can be up to 128 characters long and can include alphanumeric characters, spaces, dashes, and underscores.
B(Example) you can use the name to stop action.

options.name: outputs
options.description: Output variables for the Action.

options.name: profile
options.description: Level of details returned by the get method.

options.name: propagate
options.description: Auto propagate the chaange or deletion to the dependent resources.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: Resource-group name for an action. By default, an action is created in C(Default) resource group.

options.name: settings
options.description: Environment variables for the Action.

options.name: source
options.description: Source of templates, playbooks, or controls.

options.name: source_readme_url
options.description: URL of the C(README) file, for the source URL.

options.name: source_type
options.description: Type of source for the Template.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: state_
options.description: Computed state of the Action.

options.name: sys_lock
options.description: System lock status.

options.name: tags
options.description: Action tags.

options.name: targets_ini
options.description:
Inventory of host and host group for the playbook in C(INI) file format.
For example, C("targetsI(ini": "[webserverhost] 72.22.192.6 [dbhost]172.22.192.5").
For more information, about an inventory host group syntax,
see [Inventory host groups](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/schematics?topic=schematics-schematics-cli-reference#schematics-inventory-host-grps).

options.name: user_state
options.description: User defined status of the Schematics object.

options.name: x_github_token
options.description: The personal access token to authenticate with your private GitHub or GitLab repository and access your Terraform template.
